problems.prompt: A wave source has a frequency of 50 Hz and a wavelength of 2 meters. What is the speed of the wave?
problems.attempt_hint: Wave speed equation (v = lambda * nu) lagao.

solution_steps.narration: Wave speed ka formula use karenge.

problems.prompt: A sound wave travels at 340 m/s. If its frequency is 170 Hz, calculate its wavelength.
problems.attempt_hint: Formula ko wavelength (lambda) ke liye rearrange karo.

solution_steps.narration: Wave speed equation se hum wavelength nikalenge.
Speed ko frequency se divide karenge.

problems.prompt: A person claps his hands near a mountain and hears the echo after 3 seconds. If the speed of sound is 342 m/s, find the distance of the mountain from the person.
problems.attempt_hint: Echo mein sound do baar travel karti hai, isliye distance 2d hoga.

solution_steps.narration: Echo ke distance ka formula likhenge.
d nikalne ke liye formula ko rearrange karenge.

problems.prompt: A submarine emits a sonar pulse, which returns from an underwater cliff in 1.02 seconds. If the speed of sound in saltwater is 1531 m/s, how far away is the cliff?
problems.attempt_hint: Ye bhi ek echo ka case hai, d = (v * t) / 2 ka use karein.

solution_steps.narration: Sonar bhi echo ke principle par kaam karta hai.
Saltwater mein speed ki value put karenge.
Total distance nikal kar divide by 2 karenge.

problems.prompt: A sound wave has a frequency of 2 kHz and a wavelength of 35 cm. How much time will it take to travel a distance of 1.5 km?
problems.attempt_hint: Pehle speed nikalo, aur phir basic time = distance / speed formula use karo.

solution_steps.narration: Sabse pehle wave speed equation se sound ki speed nikalenge.
Wavelength (m) aur frequency (Hz) ki values put karenge.
Ab time nikalne ke liye standard formula lagayenge.
Distance ko meter mein convert karke speed se divide karenge.
